subject: Q3 executive packet — approval rollcall and signer list
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 executive packet — draft for internal pass

Team,

Attaching v3 of the Q3 executive packet. This version incorporates ops throughput numbers and the updated ARR bridge from finance. Please focus reviews on:

- Slides 4–7: metric narratives (we need crisp y/y commentary and one-line explanations)
- Slide 10: ask and runway — tighten language to a single concrete ask for the board
- Appendix: ensure the financial appendix reconciles to our forecast model (line items highlighted in yellow)

Timeline: I need signoff from execs by EOD Thursday so we can route to legal on Friday for the template review and DocuSign prep. If you can’t get to the deck, leave inline comments in the drive link and add a summary email reply.

Attachments: Q3_exec_packet_v3.pptx (draft), financial_appendix_v3.xlsx (workbook)

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 executive packet — draft for internal pass

Karthik — thanks for the draft. Quick notes from editorial pass:

- Exec summary (slide 2): shorten to three bullets — outcome, metric delta, ask. Current paragraph is too long for the board read.
- Metrics: on slide 5 include a one-line method note that usage = paid tokens + embeddings; that prevents questions about uptake.
- Slide 8 (Customer stories): rename to "Impact highlights" and move one customer up to slide 3 so it appears earlier.

I added comments in the deck for exact phrasing. I can take the summary bullets if Aditya is swamped this week.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Oct 2028 15:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 executive packet — draft for internal pass

On Thu, Oct 4, 2028 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Karthik — thanks for the draft. Quick notes from editorial pass:
>
> - Exec summary (slide 2): shorten to three bullets — outcome, metric delta, ask. Current paragraph is too long for the board read.
> - Metrics: on slide 5 include a one-line method note that usage = paid tokens + embeddings; that prevents questions about uptake.
> - Slide 8 (Customer stories): rename to "Impact highlights" and move one customer up to slide 3 so it appears earlier.
>
> I added comments in the deck for exact phrasing. I can take the summary bullets if Aditya is swamped this week.

Thanks — I reviewed the financial appendix and reconciled the ARR bridge to the model; there were two line items that we reclassified (R&D credits and partner rebates) — I updated the appendix and the speaker notes to reflect that. Marcus can you confirm the latency/SLI numbers on slide 6 are final for our SLO statement?

Also: we need to decide the signer list for the DocuSign packet. My recommendation: CEO + CFO + Head of Sales for the investor ask signature. If the board requires the chair also, we should include signoff routing now.

Attachments: signoff_matrix.csv (proposed routing)

-Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
VP, Finance | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Sienna Park <sienna.park@oakviewcap.com>, Rory James <rory.james@capitaladvisors.io>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 executive packet — draft for internal pass

Karthik / team — final check from my side:

- Latency SLOs on slide 6 are correct (p95 end-to-end inference latency 120ms, p99 280ms) and are reflected in the speaker notes.
- I reviewed the ask language; Laura's shorter bullets read better for the board.
- Signer list: CEO (Maya Srinivasan) + CFO (Aditya Rao) + Head of Sales (Rohan Mehta) — confirmed. Laura will add the chaironly fallback row in the signoff_matrix.csv in case Oakview asks for chair signature.

Sienna / Rory — once we have internal signoff, we'll route to you via DocuSign. Expect to send on Monday after legal final review. Do you have any timing constraints on your side for the signing window?

Sienna: if Oakview prefers an accelerated window we can prepare a one-sheet summary alongside the packet.

Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
VP, Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Attachments referenced: Q3_exec_packet_v3.pptx, financial_appendix_v3.xlsx, signoff_matrix.csv
